opportunities.title: MAYAChain Halts, Then the Real Number Comes Out: $11M, Not $1.7M
opportunities.why_now: The network halted on an initial $1.7M estimate, but hours later CoinDesk reported the drained pool value at $11M — a live case study in how exploit disclosures always undercount on day one.
opportunities.angle: Timeline breakdown post: initial estimate vs. real damage, with a running note that 'the first number is never the number'

opportunities.title: Harmony's Fix for Getting Hacked (Again): Just Delete 109,000 Transactions
opportunities.why_now: Harmony is planning a rollback erasing over 100k transactions post-exploit — the same 'immutable ledger' industry once again choosing to rewrite history instead of eating the loss.
opportunities.angle: Opinion piece on rollback-as-security-theater, with a scorecard of past chains that did the same (Ethereum Classic, etc.) and what it means for 'trustlessness'

opportunities.title: DefiLlama Delayed Its App Because Apple's Store Was Already Full of Fake DefiLlama Apps
opportunities.why_now: The founder says phishing clones on the official Apple Store forced a delay — proof that even the most security-conscious builders can't outrun platform-level scams.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on how app-store phishing clones work, screenshots of the fakes if available, and a checklist for verifying official crypto apps before download

opportunities.title: An AI Found 'Severe' Flaws in Your Bitcoin Wallet's Firmware. Humans Missed Them.
opportunities.why_now: BitBox disclosed that AI-assisted auditing caught critical firmware bugs that passed human review, a first-of-its-kind admission for a hardware wallet maker.
opportunities.angle: Deep dive on what AI code-auditing catches that manual reviews miss, framed as a wake-up call for hardware wallet due diligence, not a marketing win

opportunities.title: Trump's Crypto Firm Is Running on AI Models the US Government Calls a Security Risk
opportunities.why_now: A Trump-family-linked crypto operation is reportedly built on Chinese AI infrastructure that Washington itself has flagged — a supply-chain security story hiding inside a political one.
opportunities.angle: Security-first framing: strip the politics, walk through the actual infrastructure dependency and what it means for user data/custody risk
